entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi Diana, I'm calling about an order for a VeloBand Pulse. I'd like to start a return, if possible.
I can certainly look into that for you. To clarify, what specifically is the issue with the VeloBand? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

It's really a matter of preference. It's a great device, but just not the right fit for my workout style. The main problem is I actually tried to return it about three weeks ago, but I ran into a major website error.
I'm sorry to hear that. Can you tell me a bit more about the error you encountered?

Of course. When I went to the returns portal, the whole system seemed to be down. It kept timing out, and I couldn't print the return label no matter what I tried. I even took a screenshot of the error page because I figured this might happen.

Thank you for that detail. I'm pulling up your account now... and yes, I can see a note about a known outage on that date. I apologize for the inconvenience that caused. Let me just check the purchase date here... Okay, I see you received it 37 days ago. Let me consult our policy.

Okay, my system shows our return policy is 10 days from the date of delivery. Since you're unfortunately outside that window, I can go ahead and process this return for you immediately. I'll email you a new return label right now.

That's fantastic, thank you Diana. I appreciate you making that easy. Since I am a long-time customer and went through that system issue, would it be possible to get a small discount code for a future purchase? I'm thinking of trying one of your smart scales instead.

That's a great question. And yes, I see here you're a VIP member with us. For the trouble with the website, I'm happy to add a 15% discount to your account that you can use on your next order. How does that sound?
That sounds perfect! Thank you so much for your help today, Diana. You've been great.
You are very welcome. The return label has been sent, and the discount is active on your account. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Nope, that's everything. Have a wonderful day.
You too. Thank you for calling VeloFit.
